title: Puzzle Marathon Effects
hook: What if you solve puzzles all day?
scene: cozy study with a desk lamp and scattered puzzle pieces

beats.label: 1 HOUR
beats.line: Your eyes feel gritty and start to water.
beats.idea: Close-up of eyes blinking, tears forming

beats.label: 2 HOUR
beats.line: Your thoughts slow, focus drifts, mental fog sets in.
beats.idea: Brain gauge drops, thought bubbles move slower

beats.label: 3 HOUR
beats.line: Your heart beats faster as cortisol spikes.
beats.idea: Heart icon pulses rapidly, cortisol meter rises

beats.label: 4 HOUR
beats.line: Your shoulders hunch, lower back aches.
beats.idea: Character slouches, wavy lines show back pain

beats.label: 5 HOUR
beats.line: Your willpower fades, you make careless mistakes.
beats.idea: Hands drop puzzle pieces, error signs pop up

beats.label: 6 HOUR
beats.line: Your mouth dries out, you reach for water.
beats.idea: Mouth cracks, character grabs a glass of water

description: A rapid visual tour of the body’s response to nonstop puzzle solving.

end.line: Would you try it, yes or no?

topic: What happens if you solve puzzles continuously for hours?
